description: Fix critical bugs: wrong table names (store_products->products, store_orders->orders), nullable DTO fields causing JSON deserialization crashes, and raw error exposure to users
steps: In app/src/main/java/com/rexo/marketplace/data/repository/ShopRepository.kt: Replace ALL occurrences of 'store_products' with 'products' and ALL occurrences of 'store_orders' with 'orders'
In app/src/main/java/com/rexo/marketplace/data/repository/AdminRepository.kt: Replace ALL occurrences of 'store_products' with 'products' and ALL occurrences of 'store_orders' with 'orders'

In app/src/main/java/com/rexo/marketplace/data/repository/AdminRepository.kt: Fix AdminUserDto to make 'name' nullable: change 'val name: String = ""' to 'val name: String? = null'. Also fix ALL other fields that could be null from the database: email, role, created_at should have safe defaults. Update the getUsers() filter to use 'user.name?.contains(...)' with null-safe access

In app/src/main/java/com/rexo/marketplace/data/repository/AdminRepository.kt: Fix AdminSubmissionDto fields that could be null - campaign_title, creator_name, deliverable_url, proposal should be nullable (String? with default null)
In app/src/main/java/com/rexo/marketplace/data/repository/AdminRepository.kt: Fix AdminDepositDto fields - brand_name, payment_method, transaction_ref should be nullable
In app/src/main/java/com/rexo/marketplace/data/repository/AdminRepository.kt: Fix AdminWithdrawalDto fields - user_name, payout_method should be nullable
In app/src/main/java/com/rexo/marketplace/data/repository/AdminRepository.kt: Fix AdminProductDto fields - name, description, image_url should be nullable
In app/src/main/java/com/rexo/marketplace/data/repository/AdminRepository.kt: Fix AdminOrderDto fields - user_id, product_id should have safe defaults
In app/src/main/java/com/rexo/marketplace/data/repository/UserRepository.kt: Make UserDto.name nullable (val name: String? = null). Update ensureUserProfile to handle this properly
In app/src/main/java/com/rexo/marketplace/ui/screens/profile/ProfileScreen.kt: Handle nullable user.name throughout - use user.name ?: user.email.substringBefore('@') as display name

In ALL ViewModels (ShopViewModel, CampaignViewModel, ProfileViewModel, AdminViewModel): Sanitize error messages before exposing to UI. Replace raw exception messages with user-friendly versions. Never expose Supabase URLs. Pattern: catch (e: Exception) { sanitizeError(e.message) }

Create a utility file app/src/main/java/com/rexo/marketplace/utils/ErrorUtils.kt with a sanitizeErrorMessage(rawMessage: String?) function that strips Supabase URLs, API keys, and technical details, returning clean user-facing messages like 'Something went wrong. Please try again.' or 'No data available.'
In ShopViewModel.kt: Use the sanitizeErrorMessage utility in all catch blocks
In CampaignViewModel.kt: Use the sanitizeErrorMessage utility in all catch blocks
In ProfileViewModel.kt: Use the sanitizeErrorMessage utility in the catch block
acceptance_criteria: No raw Supabase URLs or technical errors ever shown to users
All ViewModels use sanitized error messages
verification: grep -rn 'store_products' app/src/main/java/ should return 0 results (only in Room @Entity annotations which are fine)
grep -rn 'store_orders' app/src/main/java/ should return 0 results (only in Room @Entity annotations which are fine)
Check AdminUserDto and UserDto have nullable name field
Check ErrorUtils.kt exists and has sanitizeErrorMessage function
findings: All store_products and store_orders references replaced in from() calls. Only remaining references are in Room @Entity annotations and comments (local cache table names, intentionally kept). AdminViewModel also fixed for error sanitization beyond the feature scope. AdminScreen.kt also updated to handle nullable AdminUserDto fields.
